For the first time since I was 18, I am worth more than I owe...financially speaking.

The culprit: [student loans](https://i.sli.mg/eKwmp1.jpg). About $40k+ of them. But when you're in college, you don't think about money the same way as adults, especially when you're not expected to pay it back until several years after graduating. It's kind of fucked up I started legal adulthood in crippling debt, but oh well.

By the time I hit my repayment period, I'd gone back to school for a [Master's](https://i.sli.mg/kN3wHN.png), which bought me more time in exchange for more debt. [Bane](https://i.sli.mg/beGbkR.jpg) would've been [displeased](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cVSo0oKPNy0) with my "borrowed time" strategy.

Fast forward to the Great Recession...oh shit, I have to pay this all back right now? Maxed out Amex and Visa, paid the minimum every month, cringe at the interest rates. Height of [Occupy Movement](https://i.sli.mg/ZBVX0M.jpg). Intern working 3 other paying jobs and living off [pasta](https://i.sli.mg/Ksp4mX.jpg) and whiskey. Too conservative for academia, too liberal for conservative think tanks. Switched to [business world](https://i.sli.mg/rVVnYM.png), betraying most of my life goals and principles, start making the [climb](https://i.sli.mg/mZTffY.jpg) up Mt. Solvency.

Well, I finally passed the treeline, and it [feels good man](https://i.sli.mg/XqaK7N.png). Obviously, I haven't paid off all those loans, but if I wanted to go [off-grid](https://i.sli.mg/fc46gK.jpg) today, my living assets would allow me to liquidate/net my financial freedom and my life insurance could go directly to my family when I get mauled by bears.

Deep down, I know I could find excuses to not repay my loans. I could've racked up mounds of consumer debt and declared bankruptcy under the pretense of Recession-era hardship. I could shove all my debt burden onto someone else, but I'm not going to.

Why? Because I'm a fucking man, man. [I believe in stuff](https://i.sli.mg/Z8pllZ.jpg).

Remember kids, when life hands you lemons, make [America](https://i.sli.mg/Zb1PL7.jpg) grape again.
After more than a decade, I finally have a positive net worth. Cue the Pepes!
